claims.text: Hotel Martinez sits at the centre of La Croisette, the road that curves along the coastline of Cannes.

findings.quote: You’re about 30 seconds walk from the ocean here

claims.text: Emmanuel Michele Martinez bought the land in 1927 and first opened it as a hotel in 1929.
